strengths.title: Core Strengths & Specialization
strengths.subtitle: What I truly excel at after 20+ years in the backend trenches: resilient distributed systems, clean architecture, and exponential speed with AI.

pillar1.title: Distributed & Event-Driven Architecture
pillar1.desc: Specialist in decoupling high-concurrency architectures using asynchronous messaging with AWS SQS, SNS, and EventBridge. Strict idempotency patterns, DLQ management, and fault tolerance ensuring zero event loss under extreme load spikes.

pillar2.title: Mission-Critical Backend & Microservices
pillar2.desc: Designing, scaling, and modernizing legacy monolithic codebases into high-throughput microservices using TypeScript/Node.js and PHP. High-availability systems, real-time bi-directional synchronization with global travel leaders (OTAs), and PCI-DSS compliance.

pillar3.title: Agentic AI Engineering & Tooling
pillar3.desc: Pioneering adoption of Claude Code, Antigravity, and custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) diagnostic servers. Strict Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and AI-augmented TDD: exponentially accelerating feature delivery while maintaining zero production reverts.

pillar4.title: Data Modeling, Performance & BI
pillar4.desc: Deep data architecture across relational and NoSQL engines. Expert query tuning, index optimization, and aggregation pipelines on MongoDB and SQL Server, eliminating multi-gigabyte table scans, paired with Business Intelligence foundation from POSCRM.

tabs.visionTitle: Bridging 20 Years of Backend Craftsmanship with the Agentic Era
tabs.visionP1: I have been programming and building architectures since before the cloud existed as we know it today. I have seen trends come and go, but the fundamentals remain: decoupling, idempotency, resilience, and domain clarity.
tabs.visionP2: Today I don't fight against AI tools: I integrate them into the heart of my daily workflow via Claude Code and the MCP protocol, achieving 10x delivery speed without sacrificing a shred of technical rigor.
tabs.archTitle: Architectures That Scale Under Real Fire
tabs.archP1: My approach is built on Clean Architecture and Event-Driven Design. Each service owns atomic responsibilities, communicates asynchronous events via AWS EventBridge or SQS, and ensures unexpected traffic spikes never take down business operations.
tabs.archP2: From highly normalized relational SQL databases to read-optimized NoSQL, I select the precise tool tailored to each business requirement.
tabs.sddTitle: Spec-Driven Development: Zero Hallucinations, 100% Verified Code
tabs.sddP1: Under SDD methodology, code is the byproduct of an impeccable specification. Before writing a single line, we complete Analysis, Architecture Plan, and Atomic Task Breakdown.
tabs.sddP2: Every pull request passes automated TDD unit tests (Red -> Green -> Refactor), security vulnerability scans, and performance audits before reaching production.
tabs.atsResume: Formats optimized for technical reviewers and ATS/AI engines

projects.title: Cool stuff I've built
projects.subtitle: Complex real-world problems solved with clean architecture, decoupled systems, and agentic innovation.

case1.title: Production MCP Diagnostic Server
case1.problem: Investigating what happened to a booking across 6 OTAs required manual log excavation across gigabytes of data and multiple databases. 15 to 60 minutes wasted per incident.
case1.solution: Built a custom MCP server in Next.js with hexagonal architecture and read-only access, reconstructing the entire timeline in seconds from natural language queries.
case1.impact: Turned an hour of frustrating log digging into answers in under 30 seconds.

case2.title: Availability Period Fixer
case2.problem: Detecting discrepancies between configured availability seasons and actual property bookings required manual data cross-referencing, causing slow investigations and diagnostic errors.
case2.solution: Built an internal tool that visualizes availability seasons and live bookings on an interactive graphic timeline, detects inconsistencies, and generates an automated repair proposal.
case2.impact: Eliminated diagnostic errors and drastically reduced operational investigation time by making calendar conflicts immediately visible and actionable.
case2.tvpProposal: 💡 Fix proposal: Extend High Season to cover Booking #1589 & sync rules

case3.title: Real-time OTA Inventory Synchronization Engine
case3.problem: Preventing overbooking and rate mismatches across millions of daily transactions with Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia, and Vrbo.
case3.solution: Architected a highly resilient event-driven distributed system (EDA): TypeScript/Node.js microservices, asynchronous decoupling with AWS SQS queues and fan-out via SNS, strict idempotency handling, DLQ management, and PCI-DSS compliance.
case3.impact: Overbookings dropped close to zero with rock-solid partner API stability under massive traffic spikes.

projects.personalSubtitle: Hardware, embedded systems, local Edge AI, and native applications supercharged by autonomous AI agents (Claude, Gemma, and tailored prompts).

personal1.title: AgroAI — On-Device AI Agricultural Assistant
personal1.problem: Delivering generative AI directly into the agricultural field where mobile signal is scarce or zero, with complete privacy and zero cloud dependencies.
personal1.solution: Native Android app in Kotlin running Google's Gemma LLM locally on-device (Edge AI) to plan treatments, irrigation, and crop health 100% offline.
personal1.impact: Autonomous generative AI in the farmer's pocket without cloud subscriptions or cellular connection.

personal2.title: Hyundai / Kia Gen5W — Navigation Firmware RE
personal2.problem: Investigating closed proprietary software in Hyundai/Kia Gen5W automotive navigation head units (SoC 'mango', European variant).
personal2.solution: Reverse engineering multi-gigabyte firmware images orchestrated with AI assistants: squashfs/ext4 partition breakdown, magic bytes identification, unpacking scripts, and architectural docs with CLAUDE.md.
personal2.impact: Comprehensive firmware architecture mapping and automated binary extraction tooling powered by AI.

personal3.title: Ámbar — Touchscreen HiFi Media Launcher
personal3.problem: Controlling audiophile playback (FLAC, MP3, streaming) on an ultra-wide secondary touchscreen (1920x720) without desktop UI friction.
personal3.solution: Python/Flask kiosk app integrating Kodi (JSON-RPC) and Spotify (local SMTC + Web API) wrapped in a vintage VFD/amber UI with pywebview.
personal3.impact: Dedicated vintage HiFi experience featuring real-time playback telemetry, digital VU meter, and dual-source control.

personal4.title: MD GitHub Navigator — AI-Orchestrated GitHub Markdown eReader
personal4.problem: Reading and navigating extensive technical books, architecture specs, and Markdown documentation across GitHub repositories on mobile devices is friction-heavy and fragmented.
personal4.solution: Native Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, Clean Architecture + MVI) built 100% through AI agentic workflows (Google Antigravity & Claude Code under strict SDD). Features full GFM rendering, Mermaid diagrams, reading progress tracking, and offline support.
personal4.impact: Polished eReader experience for developers, orchestrated from scratch by autonomous AI multi-agent workflows.
